name: Niger

findings.summary: Hikvision's West Africa team, with ITS Solutions, installed over 100 cameras on 12 main Niamey roads and government and hotel entrances, with a central control room and mobile viewing, for the 2019 African Union summit and lasting city use.
findings.analyst_inference: Both pages carry the same vendor-produced case study, so tiered S4 and not corroborating. Tier 5 assumed from 'operational' description; summit date (July 2019) inferred as the go-live month. Pre-2020 and current status not checked, so still_current null. Value and contracting body not stated.

findings.controller: Government of Niger (Ministry of Communication, Posts and Digital Economy)
findings.local_actor: Ministry of Communication, Posts and Digital Economy
findings.financier: African Development Bank (support reported; terms not stated)
findings.summary: Niger's digital-economy minister said the Tier III national data centre, costing about FCFA 9bn, was 13% built in early 2025 and due for handover by 30 September; one outlet reported African Development Bank support.
findings.analyst_inference: All three outlets relay the same ministerial television statements, so not treated as independent. Pole domestic on the owner-operator rule, assuming state ownership; operator and builder are not named. US$14.3m is the outlet's own conversion of FCFA 9bn. AfDB role appears in one S3 source only. Completion (Sept 2025 target) not confirmed.
